name: Black-sampson echinacea
desc: Black-sampson echinacea (Echinacea angustifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Echinacea angustifolia, the narrow-leaved purple coneflower or blacksamson echinacea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae.
